## Checklist for content changes

- [ ] Every new claim has a visible citation
- [ ] The wording is our own (not copied from a source)
- [ ] Each new source, image or dataset is added to `SOURCES.md` with its license and the date checked
- [ ] No text was copied from a share-alike source such as Wikipedia
- [ ] Where scholars or traditions disagree, the disagreement is stated and each view is attributed

Code-only change? Ignore the checklist.
